rules.title: Pin actions
rules.text: Pin third-party actions to a full-length commit SHA and verify it belongs to the action repository, not a fork.

rules.title: Least-privilege permissions
rules.text: Set explicit minimal permissions on the GITHUB_TOKEN per workflow.

rules.title: Cache dependencies
rules.text: Cache dependencies and cancel superseded runs with concurrency groups.

rules.title: No secrets in logs
rules.text: Never echo secrets and avoid pull_request_target with untrusted code.

rules.title: Reusable workflows
rules.text: Share logic through reusable workflows and composite actions.

rules.title: OIDC for cloud auth
rules.text: Authenticate to clouds with OIDC instead of stored long-lived keys.

rules.title: Matrix builds
rules.text: Test supported versions with a build matrix.

rules.title: Avoid pull_request_target
rules.text: Avoid pull_request_target workflows. Route privileged automation through a reviewed dispatcher.

rules.title: Path filters with a cheap gate
rules.text: Use path filters so expensive jobs run only when relevant files change, and keep a cheap required check on every PR.
